name: zkLink
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: The Discord server of the cross-chain trading platform zkLink has been hacked, and some hackers posted phishing links. Do not click on any links until the team confirms that they have regained control of the server.
